Scope: infrastructure networks over about 3.5 km² in Zones A and B and the Labour Community Area, around 100 km south-east of Riyadh.

Status at a glance

Progress is measured as physical % complete, weighted by budgeted man-hours. Against the revised plan issued on 26 Oct, the project is 0.24% ahead: 51.05% complete against 50.81% planned. The lead is down from 0.62% last week, because this week's gain of 0.62% fell short of the 1.01% planned.

The P6 update now finishes 7 days after the contract date, and every open milestone slipped another week. The P6 update uploaded this week (data date 10-Nov-2026) finishes the project on 09-Dec-2027 with −6 days of float, while the weekly report still gives 02-Dec-2027 with no variance. Road works are now forecast for 09-Jan-2027 and the MV network for 15-Feb-2027, 99 and 136 days after their baseline dates. Weekly progress fell below plan, and asphalt works still face a bitumen supply constraint. Against the original baseline, which called for 83.0% by the end of October, the project remains far behind.

Every open P6 milestone moved exactly 7 days, so the driving work did not advance this week. All interim milestones and the project finish are one week later than in last week's update, the same as the move in the data date. Open activities with negative float rose from 574 to 610, led by bituminous construction (20) and aggregate base course (19). The worst float, −116 days, sits on the MV works and on the asphalt binder and base course chain. P6 finishes the telecom network on 02-Jun-2027, two months after the weekly report's "All networks" forecast of 05-Apr-2027.

Data notes

  • The weekly report gives a forecast completion of 02-Dec-2027 with zero variance, but the P6 update uploaded with it finishes on 09-Dec-2027 with −6 days of float. 56 open activities, mainly GRP pipes, street lighting and curbstone, still finish after the project finish, up to 09-Oct-2028.
  • The main summary sheet again shows the milestone forecasts as the baseline dates, while its own days-change column and the Milestones sheet give −99, −136 and −62 days.
  • Invoice Log: the gross value of invoices 1–5 now equals last week's amount after retention (invoice 1: 1,513,698 instead of 1,681,886), and retention shows 0 instead of 4,971,066. The 58,434,344 "gross" total is therefore after retention for those invoices. The log measures it against 307,891,320 (19.0%), the summary against 267,731,582 (21.8%), and the summary still counts 0 submitted invoices.
  • The 11-Nov progress presentation has its network layouts and material progress sheet as images only, so quantities by network and zone are not available again this week.
  • Quality: the period is written "01-November-2026 to 07-October-2026"; cumulative approved FIRs read 54,230 in Quality-Stat but 2,855 issued in the summary panel; cumulative approved MIRs read 250 (238 + 12) against 5 last week and 49 in the summary. The Quality-Stat sheet also reports cost-based progress as "actual"; it is not used here.
  • Procurement: delivery completion dates were moved to 29/30-Nov for six items, while MV cable, lighting poles, sluice valves and GRP pipes still show 20-Oct although they are incomplete. Interlock deliveries rose again although supply is recorded as on hold.
  • The photo titles in the Weekly Progress Photos sheet ("Concrete barriers delivery", "Temporary mobilization Area", "Start works in Area A") do not match the photos, which have no date or GPS stamp.
